subject: [PATCH v2 2/5] nfsd: Honor delegated timestamps when change and size match

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch updates the NFS server to honor delegated timestamps when a client's change and size attributes match those of the server. This ensures that clients holding timestamp delegations have their atime and mtime updated correctly, even after flushed writes or other changes. The patch also adds logging instead of failing on failed time application, and annotates lockless accesses for clarity.
